mapper.select: select count(*) from board where usernum = #{usernum}
select no from board where usernum = #{usernum} order by no desc limit #{offset},10
select no,title, date(wdate) as wdate, hit, (select count(*) from recommend where no = #{no}) as recCount, (select count(*) from reply where no = #{no}) as repCount from board where no = #{no}
select count(*) from reply where usernum = #{usernum}
select rno, no, rnote, date(rwdate) as rwdate from reply where usernum = #{usernum} order by rno desc limit #{offset},10
select count(*) from guest where hostnum = #{usernum}
select gno,gnote,guestnum,date(gwdate) as gwdate, (select userid from user where usernum = guest.guestnum) as userid from guest where hostnum = #{usernum} order by gno desc limit #{offset},10
select count(*) from guest where guestnum = #{guestnum} and gno = #{gno}
